description: Add an item to a menu. A custom link needs url; a page/post or term item needs object_type post_type/taxonomy plus object and object_id of an existing object. Only the given fields are sent; the plugin defaults the rest (object_type custom, parent 0, appended at the end). target, classes, xfn, attr_title, description and status are set afterwards with mcp_update_menu_item.

object.description: Post type or taxonomy slug of the linked object (page, post, category, product_cat, ...)

object_id.description: ID of the linked post or term

object_type.description: Item type: custom (link with url), post_type (page, post, CPT) or taxonomy (category, product_cat, ...). Plugin default: custom

parent.description: Parent menu item ID (an item of the same menu; 0 = top level)

name: mcp_add_menu_item
